title: User Run key autostarts
whyItMatters: Programs listed here start automatically for this account. Their value names show background tools that keep running after sign-in.
source: Microsoft Learn, Run and RunOnce registry keys: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/setupapi/run-and-runonce-registry-keys
notes: Per-user autostart list. Command strings are not read; only value counts are reported. Registry last-write time is unavailable (D3).

steps: Open Task Manager and check the Startup apps tab to see which entries you still need.
Open Registry Editor and go to the key named in the plan.
Delete the values for the programs you no longer want to start at sign-in.
cleanup.risk: Removes those programs from this account's autostart list. The programs stay installed and only stop starting by themselves.
